name: Anemone
author: E. T. Carter
description: A bed of sea-anemone organisms filling dark water — each a ring of soft tentacle lobes built from polar petal SDFs, rim-lit with a warm core, breathing open and closed on a long eased cycle with the contraction rippling around the ring while tips sway and spiral. Blooms scatter on a jittered grid at varied sizes, lobe counts, breath phases and palette rotations, overlapping into a dense translucent anemone field.

params.label: Breath speed
params.effect: Rate of the open/close easing cycle; the whole field flexes faster or slower.

params.label: Bloom size
params.effect: Base radius of each anemone in CSS pixels; larger blooms with the same density fill more boldly.

params.label: Lobe count
params.effect: Base number of tentacle lobes per organism (varied a little per bloom); few reads as broad petals, many as a fine fringed fan.

params.label: Density
params.effect: How tightly the anemone bed packs; higher shrinks the spacing so more blooms overlap and fill the frame.

params.label: Twist
params.effect: Spiral twist of the tentacles, from straight radial lobes to a swirling pinwheel.
